Verdicts: BUGGY / FIXED (relevant questions), SAME / NEITHER (questions where both versions behave the same), UNDETERMINED. Second set: 10 questions sampled uniformly (seed 7) from judge v2's relevant questions outside the first set (out/judge_sample.txt); relevant null = undecidable, excluded.
